scientific_scope.2d_deflection: Finite-start nonrotating orbital illustration; alpha ≈ 4GM/(bc²) is a weak-field trend, not a prediction of the strong-field disk image.
scientific_scope.2d_image_mapping: Dimensionless point-mass thin-lens map beta = theta − theta_E² theta/|theta|²; extended source mapped point by point.
scientific_scope.3d: Adaptation of the previous original Schwarzschild visualization; finite integration and initial camera mapping are approximate, appearance and timing are stylized, no complete relativistic radiative transfer or Kerr spin.
scientific_scope.authenticity: Scientific illustration, not telescope observations. Source is original project code/text; no reference MV scene code/song or cloned human voice used.
scientific_scope.ai_voice: Public zh-CN-YunxiNeural synthetic voice; narration explicitly disclosed as AI-generated.

archive_scope: Source, original audio, voice segments, captions, production/review notes, final technical reports, actually viewed final contact sheet/atlases/two full-resolution images. Final MP4, old study/stills, individual audit frames and node_modules are excluded.
